reply_text:
Thanks for telling me, Nadia. I'll keep it to this conversation. I won't pass the Bluefin/Albany news to Ruth or anyone else, and I won't post it in any channel.

I haven't checked it against anything, so it's still Mateo's word. If you want to do something with it, I can help with that. For example, I could draft a note for you to send Ruth yourself, or set up time for you to brief her. What would you like to do?
